name: TC-448: placing the cart charges nothing — the basket lands in 'We're designing it' with the estimate, and the owner is told so by email
description: Place order checks the cart out into a basket (SupplyCheckout, SC-YYYY-NNNN) and commits each line without charging. Every catalog product needs artwork, so the line lands in IN_DESIGN (not PLACED). The line shows the range as an estimate, paymentTerm is IMMEDIATE, the cart is empty, and one 'checkoutPlaced' email names the basket and says nothing was charged.
